page.layout: Running head at top: "Cap.30." at left, "AVGVSTINVS" at right. One column of text, then a decorative ornament, the centred heading "CAP. XXX." with its subtitle, then one column of text with a historiated initial, a woodcut initial, and a continuing column. No margin notes. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.p: schatis festum in Ecclesia Christiana commemorari & celebrari debere voluerunt, quum non Pascha, sed Coena Domini fit nobis nec quidem semel tantum in anno, sed quoties coetus commoditas id patitur, celebranda. 2 Poenitentiam hominibus post Baptismum lapsis denegant. Id quod ex Nouatianorum fæce sumptum est, seu potius a Nouatianis ex Quartidecimanorum errore. Socrat. lib.5. cap. 22. Sic de-lirant, ut ait Augustinus lib.2. contra Faust. qui sinam doctrinam non sustinentes, ad fabulas convertuntur.
main_text.head: CAP. XXX.
Alogiani cur dicti. Erroris autem eorum capita duo recensentur.

p.i: A[?]logiani proterea sic{1}vocantur, tanquam sine verbo (λόγος enim Graece verbum dicitur) quia Deum Verbum recipere noluerunt, Ioannis Euangelium respuentes, cuius nec Apocalypsin accipiunt. Has videlicet Scripturas negant esse ipsius.

main_text.p: 1 Sic vocantur.) Immanior vero & tetrior superiore fuit hæc pestis & hæresis, de qua nunc sumus dicturi: quam qui sequuntur, Alogi, Alogij, Alogiani, & Artemonitæ vocantur. His enim tot nominibus una illa secta dicta est. Ἀλόγοι[?] quidem & Ἀλόγια[?] ab Epiphanio & alijs: quas voces Latini Alogos & Alogianos verterunt, uti

page.notes: The running head reads "Cap.30." at left, which is a chapter marker rather than a page number, so no page number is given. The initial at the start of the italic paragraph is an ornamental letter that looks like A; read as A[?]logiani, doubtful. "sinam" (printed "finam", long s) is a doubtful reading. The Greek words at the end of the paragraph are doubtful at the line break ("Ἀλο-" / "γοι"). The "1" after "sic" is a reference mark; its note is the paragraph beginning "Sic vocantur.)", printed in the text column.
